# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules set -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules set <name> (--branch B | --tag T | --tag-pattern P | --commit SHA)

Change the tracking configuration of a submodule in .gitmodules, and nothing
else; run 'update' afterwards. An unmanaged submodule becomes managed.
Exactly one of --branch, --tag, --tag-pattern and --commit is required;
an abbreviated commit is expanded when it is available locally.

Options:
  --branch <branch>        track the tip of the remote branch
  --commit <commit>        track the commit (a full or abbreviated SHA)
  --tag <tag>              track the tag
  --tag-pattern <pattern>  track the highest version tag matching pattern
